name: Rohit Bhattiprolu
positioning: Controls/GNC engineer who thinks in systems terms.

paragraphs: I'm an Aerospace Engineering + Business student, Class of [graduation year], focused on the controls and systems side of spacecraft and aircraft design. I'm drawn to problems where the math has to close the loop with hardware — not just simulate cleanly on paper.

I most recently worked as a production engineering intern at an aerospace hardware company, where I supported additive manufacturing (FDM/SLS) process documentation and built in-house tooling to track parts through production.

Right now I'm going deep on proximity operations and in-space manufacturing — the guidance, navigation, and control problems that show up when spacecraft have to operate near each other or build things on-orbit. The projects below are how I'm building that depth.
